title: 2004 Year of the Monkey First Day Cover USPS 37¢ Stamp San Francisco FDI Art
descriptionText:
2004 USPS First Day Cover featuring the Year of the Monkey stamp with official San Francisco cancellation (Jan 13, 2004).
This version includes illustrated art card design with monkey artwork and printed description inside, making it more collectible than standard blank envelopes.
Good condition overall with light handling wear. See photos for details.
